title: edit.redo
description: Redoes the entry on top of OpenTune's redo history if it is the entry that expectedUndoId names (PROTOCOL.md section 15.3). Otherwise the call fails with UNDO_CONFLICT(top_mismatch), unless force is true; clients set force only when the end user explicitly asked to redo a change that was not made through the client. An empty history gives UNDO_CONFLICT(history_empty), also with force; an entry recorded through this API before a track was deleted gives UNDO_CONFLICT(stale_entry) unless force is true; a clip split, merge or delete gives UNSUPPORTED(undo_unsafe_build), also with force. An entry recorded in the UI before a track was deleted is applied with the warning UNDO_ENTRY_POSSIBLY_STALE. A step that changes nothing still succeeds, with noOp true and the warning UNDO_NO_EFFECT; as in OpenTune, the step is used up and the project is marked as changed. entry is the entry that was applied; if it had no undoId, the server assigns one now (section 15.3 rule 8). revisionDiff and changes describe the effect, from snapshots taken before and after the step; a content whose notes or pitch curve changed is listed as an entry of entity content with the field revision. Like the UI, the server then refreshes derived state; work this queues is reported in sideEffects. The step creates no undo entry of its own (undo reason ui_parity); its revert recipe is edit.undo with the entry's undoId.
